description: Na₂MgGd₂Si₄(O₆F)₂ is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six O and one F atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.99 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.33 Å. Mg is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form MgO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. All Mg-O bond lengths are 2.11 Å. Both Mg-F bond lengths are 1.99 Å. Gd is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six O and two equivalent F atoms. There are a spread of Gd-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.91 Å. Both Gd-F bond lengths are 2.50 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₄F₂ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 54°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.69 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₄F₂ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 58°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.68 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Gd, and one Si atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂GdSi tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Mg, one Gd, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na, one Gd, and two Si atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Gd and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two Si atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, one Gd, and one Si atom. F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and two equivalent Gd atoms.
